newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips firm anew, techs still weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips firm anew, techs still weak.

text.p: Wall Street stocks extended their mixed performance in late afternoon on Tuesday, with blue chips pushing higher but tech stocks mired in losses.
The Dow rose 31 points to 7320, returning to the moderate gains it had held for most of the afternoon. The Nasdaq Composite fell 16 to 1388, dragged down by a sharp sell-off in networking shares.

Financial stocks rallied, boosted by a firm bond market. The Philadelphia Stock Exchange's bank index tacked on a two percent gain and the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury rallied 9/32 to yield 6.88 percent.
